title: How Divorce Affects Children & Co-Parenting After Separation | Working Moms Podcast Ep. 8
description:
How Divorce Affects Children & Co-Parenting After Separation | Working Moms Podcast Ep. 8

📺 In Episode 8 of the Working Moms Podcast, we're having one of our most heartfelt conversations yet—how divorce affects children and what parents can do to help their kids cope, heal, and thrive through this life-changing transition.
👩‍👧‍👦 Whether you're currently navigating co-parenting, blending families, or just seeking support as a mom, this episode offers real talk, emotional insight, and faith-based encouragement. We’re sharing our personal journeys through divorce—both as daughters and as divorced mothers—and offering tools that help us stay grounded, present, and strong for our children.
💬 What You'll Learn in This Episode:
-How children internalize divorce and what signs to look for
-How to talk to your kids about separation in an age-appropriate way
-Co-parenting tips for maintaining peace and consistency
-The role of prayer, faith, and community in emotional healing
-Creating a safe space for your children to open up

PLUS: Real estate tips for home buyers in today’s market!

🎯 Whether you're a working mom, stepmom, single parent, or simply walking with a friend through this—this episode is a must-watch.

🛑 Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe so you never miss an episode!

👇 Got questions or a story to share? Drop it in the comments—we’d love to hear from you.
